profile.summary: UC Merced is a public land-grant research university in Merced County, California. It is the tenth and newest campus of the University of California system, which opened in 2005.

review.notes: The agenda names the Regents of the University of California on behalf of UC Merced, a public university campus, and the profile describes exactly that campus; the Wikipedia source supports the summary (public land-grant research university in Merced County, tenth and newest UC campus, established 2005) and orgType. The summary is neutral and all other fields are null; an HR/talent MOU with a UC campus is plausible.
